related_questions.question: What to do if you have a dental emergency and no dentist?
related_questions.snippet: When your dentist won't see you after hours or there is no ``emergency dentist'', only option for true dental emergencies is the ER. Typically this would need to include pain with swelling- and the ER would only aim to reduce pain with possible pain meds/antibiotics. Try alternating heat and cold.

related_questions.question: Can I get dental care in the emergency room?
related_questions.snippet: What can an emergency room do for a toothache? Emergency room providers can give you medications, such as antibiotics or pain relievers, to alleviate pain and swelling. But they don't perform restorative treatments, such as fillings or crowns.
